description: Everything in mailmoose.dev/email, plus the MX record that delivers the domain's incoming mail to MailMoose. Replaces any existing MX records, so it is only offered for a domain that receives no mail elsewhere, or once the person has chosen to move their mail.
variableDescription: dkim1, dkim2, dkim3: Amazon SES DKIM tokens, which verify the domain for receiving mail. pmselector: the Postmark DKIM selector, e.g. 20261018192056pm. pmdkimkey: the Postmark DKIM public key, the base64 after p=.
